mapper.select: SELECT id, '0001A110000000002ZWA' AS parent_id, position_name AS title FROM fms_position_archive WHERE type = 'CJ' AND region = '0001A110000000002ZWA' AND status = '0'

SELECT pa.position_name AS workshop_name, -- 从车间表获取车间名称 pl.prod_line_name AS line_name, -- 从产线表获取产线名称 wg.work_group_name, -- 获取班组表的所有字段信息 wg.id, CONCAT(pa.position_name, '-', pl.prod_line_name, '-', wg.work_group_name) AS title -- 拼接名称 FROM -- 基础表：车间归档表，并设置别名为 pa fms_position_archive pa JOIN -- 连接产线表 (pl)，关联条件是 车间id = 产线中的work_shop_id fms_prod_line pl ON pa.id = pl.work_shop_id JOIN -- 连接班组表 (wg)，关联条件是 产线id = 班组中的prod_line_id fms_work_group wg ON pl.id = wg.prod_line_id WHERE -- 设置 fms_position_archive 表的筛选条件 -- 您可以根据需要修改这些值 pa.type = 'CJ' AND pa.region = '0001A110000000002ZWA' AND pa.status = '0'
SELECT dict_value AS id, dict_label AS title FROM swm_dict_data WHERE dict_type = 'person_type_enum' AND status = '0'
SELECT dict_label AS id, dict_label AS title FROM swm_dict_data WHERE status = '0' ORDER BY dict_label
select * from swm_helmet_device_config where device_id = #{deviceId} and status = '0'
